description: Get the JSON catalog download URL. Download it with your API key; the catalog carries inventory and required notices. This tool makes no API request.

include_skin_tones.description: Include skin-tone variants. Explicit false excludes them.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

max_version.description: Latest Emoji release to include, such as 16.0.

version.description: Exact Emoji release version, such as 17.0.
